notes.title: Time to Morp - Available Now With 20% Launch Discount!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/beca3b2ea350128d24607c813d6921fc1b954944.png

Missed us?
You might know us as the devs behind your favorite (surely) game, Dude, Stop. Well, guess what? We're pumped to let you know that after four years of hard work, we've just dropped our latest creation: Time to Morp!

[previewyoutube=xcRi5bC5KVA;full][/previewyoutube]

Discounts!
We are not only offering a 2 week long 20% launch discount for Time to Morp, we will also be rewarding people who pick up the Time to Morp Launch Bundle with an additional 10% off. Simply head to the bundle page for this extra special promotion.

Early Access
Time to Morp is now in Early Access, and we really value gathering feedback of Interns as we keep refining the game. By focusing on what the community of dedicated Morpers wants most, we believe we can make a much better game. Our plan is to keep Time to Morp in early access for approximately 12 months. The current version includes many core features and about 40% of the story and narrative. Remember: errors in Time to Morp can happen, if you encounter any please report them here. Few things to notice before we land and you can take on a mission:

[olist]
    Day One Patch Notes are available here.
    Controller Support - still in works, and some UIs do not support native controls. But it is fully possible to relax on a couch and play with a controller in your hands!
    Map Generation  -  still experimental, but provides nice replayability and fresh experience. You can still play on a hand-made map if you want a stable playthrough.
[/olist]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977510/Time_to_Morp/ 

Show must go on!
Just because we've launched Early Access doesn't mean we're kicking back! The crew got a ton more to toss into the mix to spruce up our ship called Time to Morp. The Engineer whipped up a Roadmap to clue the Interns in on what's coming down the pipeline:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/1cd7566be445d2814f58505cac74df8acdac29f2.png
Report Errors and Leave Feedback
To continue contributing to development, we encourage you to leave feedback and report any errors you encounter along the way:
[olist]
To Leave Feedback - Start new discussion here or join our Discord Server and use dedicated channel! 
Report Errors - Detailed information on how to report errors can be found here.
[/olist]
It's finally Morpin Time!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38670119/98e477d3ba1dfc6f33b9759f76ff35f91604ebaa.png

notes.title: Mac, Linux & Open Localization!
notes.content:
New patch for “Dude, Stop” is out!

https://i.imgur.com/cFSVeIK.gif

MAC & LINUX

We were running closed beta for Linux and Mac for some time now, and since everything is working, it’s time to invite more people! The Open Beta is Live!!

Look at this gif to find out how to download it and test it for yourself and don’t forget to tell us if it worked for you!

https://i.imgur.com/tmyILHH.gif

Plus, you can read a little more here: → Blog psot ← 

LOCALIZATION

Some time ago we promised you localization news and here they are: Localization is now... open!
What does that mean? Well, exactly that. Go into the game’s folder, look for the “Localization” folder and do whatever you want with it!! Add new languages (copy “EN” folder and rename it to something else) or change all current phrases to “I’M GROOT” or something, or... OR! Add new jokes!! Yeap, you can do even that!... Not voiced jokes, but rather those text thingies at the end of the puzzle! Add as much as you like, and share your file with us!

P.S. It’s not a replacement for proper localization - we were preparing files for translators and decided to make them public.

CONCLUSION

We are still doing the do, still making some adjustment, and still looking forward to your feedback! So don’t forget to share how good your Mac build is working or what imaginary language you managed to add to the game!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png

notes.title: Current progress (May)
notes.content:
Let’s talk about the Contest, Localizations, and... another Contest?

https://i.imgur.com/IeF99mY.gif

CONTEST #1 and #2

For the last couple of days we’ve been trying to run two contests on our Discord server, where we already gave away a couple of FREE COPIES of the game on Steam. And it’s going kinda well! So let’s extend it to this cozy place as well!

How do you participate? Well, you need to take a picture of something that suits the “Dude, Stop” spirit, or you need to come up with a joke! That easy!... But full rules are a little bit longer, so go read them in Contest #1 or Contest #2 discussions or in our latest Blog post here..

https://i.imgur.com/7rbkfbG.png

For more motivation, you can scroll through the submissions so far on this special website: www.duckabase.com
And don’t ask why it’s called like that. Just don’t.

LOCALIZATION

Now onto the Bad news!!
On the day of the release, June 1st, “Dude, Stop” will have only 1 language: English voice over and English subtitles/UI.

We sincerely apologize to everyone who was waiting for this feature, and for false promises from our side. We hope to make it up to you shortly after the release.

The reason is that we cramped too much text and voice into the game and in the end we had no time to translate it before the release. But worry not! Localization IS available in our game, with all the “change language” options and fully working implementation. We just need to get ourselves a proper translator and some time. So expect more news about it after the release!

Please read this and other news here (and 4 new screenshots, as always!!)

--> More information <--


STEAM NEWS

We have submitted the game to Steam for a review. We already have achievements, and currently working on Trading cards and badges. Oh, and the Release trailer is also coming along nicely!

CONCLUSION

Once again, sorry for promising too much. But localization will return a little bit later, since all the support for it is already built in and tested. And we still hope to see you on the day of the release for moral support, at least, so don’t go away! Trailer soon, contest in progress, and we’re in Discord! That’s all.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png

One of the conditions* to win a FREE COPY of the game, is to follow all this links: Discord Server, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Instagram and: https://www.patomkin.com/

notes.title: Current progress (April)
notes.content:
The game is ready!... Or is it? Let’s find out together!

https://i.imgur.com/MA0uXGR.gif

GAME IS READY *question mark*

As you know (or don’t) the biggest task left to do was the Audio! All the sounds, music, voice effects... it affects mood and atmosphere and is basically the most important thing in the game. And it’s kind of ready! And by “kind of” I mean that it’s totally playable! Stuff is missing here and there, and some places require a couple fixes, but we should be able to mend it all before the release...

THE RELEASE DATE *dot dot dot*

If the game is playable, and the Audio is ready, then what now?! Should we announce the release date?! We totally should! But we won’t. 
...okay, okay, now calmly move the mouse away from the dislike button - there are couple reasons for us not announcing the date: we still need the final trailer, a couple more playtests and do the other... stuff. So no release date for now. Sorry :(

Just to be clear: the game won’t be out next week. Or the week after that... Basically, we need more time to prepare. But when the time comes, you’ll be the first to know.

BLOG POST

Yeah, we have yet another blog post on IndieDB, that you MUST check here:

 -> Blog post  Blog post again <- 

RANDOM FACT #3

Ducks are real.

CONCLUSION

Even if “The Game is Ready”, we still have some stuff to do! And it will take some time! But we are close! Closer than ever! We just need to finish with some legal stuff, illegal stuff, trailer stuff, localization stuff, and the other stuff. So please be excited, but not like crazy excited, ok?

Love ya, cheers.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png

Feel free to express your emotions towards this piece of... art... in the comments! I’m gonna collect them and bind them and read them as bedtime horror stories to the programmer. Don’t be gentle.

http://dudestop-game.com/

MUSIC AND SOUNDS

The Composer has sent us a build with new sounds and music, and oh! OH! It’s so nice! It’s like we have all these screams, and intense music, and, like, sounds... and stuff! And all of it works!... Well, except for the last pack and another list of bugs we found, but still - we have music! And sounds! And the voice sounds even angrier now!

MY DINNER TODAY

Beans.

CONCLUSION

Still alive, still working, doing music, sounds and bug fixes. Also we have a new website for some reason, and are planning on a trailer. Or... do we need one? We already have, like, 4 videos or something. Do they count as a trailer? Hm... Anyway! Thank you for waiting, and thank you for commenting, posting, asking, messaging us and remembering that we still exist! Cya next time!

notes.title: Current progress (January)
notes.content:
We did the unspeakable - we finished voicing the game!!

https://i.imgur.com/RxZCpT4.gif

THE VOICE IS OVER

Yes, it finally happened! After couple of weeks of recording sessions with our angry screaming voice actor, we placed a stamp of approval on the audio files we received, and we even did a little bit more - we invited two more VAs! That makes it THREE Voice Actors in the game!!... Two of them have really episodical roles, but still - it’s a thing to brag about. So be excited! (That’s an order.)

Oh yeah, almost forgot - after we recorded everything, we also implemented everything. So it's not only gameplay, it's also the narrator speaking, the whole package, the glorious goodness. AS IF IT WAS AN ALMOST COMPLETE GAME NOW! Whoo-hoo!! Let's celebrate with one more year of development. (jk)

THE BLOG

As usually, we wrote a small blog post with funny text:

 -> Read here <- 

It’s basically the same news, but the words are different. Yeah... Ok, I don’t know what else to add here. Hm. NEXT TOPIC!

THE REST

...did we mention that we are still waiting for the sounds and music? Oh yeah, we still are. That’s the one and only thing we are waiting for. We are also researching localizations (since the text is over-voiced and there is no turning back now), and calculating how many dictionaries we need to read before we can do it ourselves... Or maybe we’ll find someone. Maybe. 

Meanwhile, we decided to do a proper landing page for the game. It’s gonna have cool art, some Dude-Stop-ish buttons, and should be a cool website to NEVER share with your friends. #ReversePsychology

CONCLUSION

And that’s all for today. We can go on and on about our plans, and dreams, and hopes, and how I failed to kiss a girl in seventh grade and six people got in ER because of that… but knowing you, you are probably more interested in the links to our social media, am I right? notes.title: First Teaser
notes.content:
Woohoo, first Teaser for “Dude, Stop” is out!
-> WATCH IT HERE <-

https://i.imgur.com/33LEQfK.gif

THE VOICE IS BACK

As you can see (hear?), we brought back the same guy that was in the trailer! And he is as angry and as funny as before!! Right now we are in the middle of recording the script and it goes amazingly fast. We have already did a few sessions and there’s only a couple more until the end. Then on to implementing all of it into the game.

EARLY 2018

Yep, the teaser actually has “Early 2018” in the end, and somewhere within that range is a date we are aiming at. Voice implementation is the second-to-last step right now and it is going ahead really good. So... if nothing changes and a freaking meteorite does not land into our servers, we should not miss the date this time :D

IS IT A GAMEPLAY VIDEO?

In case someone gets scared that the teaser doesn’t look like a game - you are right, it does not. It’s not a gameplay video. “Dude, Stop” has the same visuals, art, mood and voice, but with actual puzzles and stuff to click. This video is just to showcase the voice in a funny, Dude-Stop-ish way :)

CONCLUSION

We are going back to recording the rest of the script! Cya at the end of the year with another more detailed “Current Progress” blog!

Oh, and if we don’t see you - have a happy holiday and stay safe!

notes.title: Current progress (October)
notes.content:
We played the game! (that’s the theme of this blog post)

Hello! We are back, as usual, with another monthly report. This time there aren’t a lot of news and things to announce, but we need to keep the tradition, so let’s talk about the most exciting one for now:

WE DID PLAYTHROUGHS

We invited few testers and set them down to play “Dude, Stop” from start to finish while we watched! And it was... fun! First of all - they all finished the game! Nothing crashed, there were no game-breaking bugs, all puzzles were clear to understand and solvable, and we even heard some laughs and giggles! One comment was even “I want to play it again”! Can you imagine this?! “Again!” This is just... oh. So cool!

WE GATHERED FEEDBACK

6 PAGES OF IT, to be exact! It was great overall, but still not all positive and shiny - there were many bugs and problems! Mostly in the same vein, like, “move that” and “change color here”, which isn’t hard to fix, but still quite time-consuming. But hey, last time it was 10 pages of game breaking bugs, so I’ll call it a success after all! 

WE WROTE A BLOG POST

This, and more in our latest blog post! Please, click the link below to read it and peek at NEW GIFS AND SCREENSHOTS! We will appreciate it!

Link: http://patomkin.com/s/we-played

https://i.imgur.com/qGkzMch.gif

CONCLUSION

Still, we need to inform you that testing was done without the new voice. We do have subtitles and we did test all the lines, and now we have 50+ places in the script that sound weird, so we need to fix those before we move on to the last major development step. But that’s gonna be our next post! See ya then!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/dcccb0f3979623f964b096ffb3302576e1a4cbe6.png

Aaaand how could we end this without our social media links:
 Facebook, Twitter and: http://patomkin.com/

notes.title: Current progress (September)
notes.content:
We have 100 puzzles ready! Yes! It’s so cool! You can start the game and play any puzzle you want. First puzzle, for example. Or second. Maybe third, if you feel like it. Ooh, you’ll like the fourth! And the fifth!.. OK-ok, let’s calm down and start from the top. *breath in, breath out*

Welcome, reader of Current Progress!

Today’s monthly progress report will be more about numbers, since most of the stuff is finally coded in and won’t change much (only improves). So let’s get to numbers.

WHAT WE HAVE:

13 packs
100 puzzles
65 trophies
900+ voiced events
1500+ subtitle lines
450+ unique text endings for puzzles
400+ sound effects
And 3 new gifs to share!

You can find a more detailed explanation regarding those numbers in our latest blog post: http://patomkin.com/s/100-puzzles Also, 2 more gifs and 4 screenshots!

https://i.imgur.com/MdXTNZa.gif

WHAT'S LEFT:

Voiceover is still a big task for us, but at least now the script is ready and there is technology to implement it easily. Other, smaller, tasks are: sounds, music, Steam achievements and couple improvements here and there...

But the most time-consuming task for us will be to playtest the game. After all, we want the game get mad at you for breaking stuff and not other way around! And that’s why game won’t come out in the next month. And not even in the month after that. We hope you’ll still be with us then! :)

notes.title: Current progress (July)
notes.content:
Hello, guys and gals!
Let us bring you up to speed with what we’ve been up to for the last 6 month.

WHAT WE HAVE:

“Dude, Stop” now has a story! Meaning, that it’s not just an “angry voice that shouts at you”, but an “angry voice that shouts at you FOR A REASON”! There are plot twists and side characters; there are secrets and enemies; there is a literal (no, not literal) emotional rollercoaster… Basically, we tried to squeeze out of the voice as much as we could.

Script is 91.3% ready! This includes voice lines for the puzzles, implementation of said lines in the game, subtitles, award descriptions and a lot of flavor text here and there to improve puzzles and overall experience!

Save slots! We know you love ‘em, we know you need ‘em and now WE GOT ‘EM. Basically to allow multiple playthroughs and to keep your little brother from messing things up.

Reworked UI and other Graphics! We have remade the options menu to make your life a little bit easier (at least inside the game); there are new graphics for the Main Menu and many-many new backgrounds.

http://i.imgur.com/unhCzUI.gif

Fixed a bunch of bugs and made lots of small improvements like new animations, graphics for puzzles, juicy particles and etc.


WHAT IS LEFT TO DO:

Finish the script, which shouldn’t take much time (haha, very funny) 
Hire an actual Voice Actor to voice over over our voice over
Finish implementing music, sounds and voice lines, which is, again, 95% ready
Playtest, polish, and make a nice trailer!


A CONFESSION:

notes.content:

Let us bring you up to speed with what we’ve been up to for the last 6 month.

WHAT WE HAVE:

“Dude, Stop” now has a story! Meaning, that it’s not just an “angry voice that shouts at you”, but an “angry voice that shouts at you FOR A REASON”! There are plot twists and side characters; there are secrets and enemies; there is a literal (no, not literal) emotional rollercoaster… Basically, we tried to squeeze out of the voice as much as we could.

Script is 91.3% ready! This includes voice lines for the puzzles, implementation of said lines in the game, subtitles, award descriptions and a lot of flavor text here and there to improve puzzles and overall experience!

Save slots! We know you love ‘em, we know you need ‘em and now WE GOT ‘EM. Basically to allow multiple playthroughs and to keep your little brother from messing things up.

Reworked UI and other Graphics! We have remade the options menu to make your life a little bit easier (at least inside the game); there are new graphics for the Main Menu and many-many new backgrounds.

http://i.imgur.com/unhCzUI.gif

Fixed a bunch of bugs and made lots of small improvements like new animations, graphics for puzzles, juicy particles and etc.

notes.title: Welcome! + FAQ inside
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27371218/790dc76ced4144a31b7f8af947f908e83ee71030.png

Hello, everyone!

As you can see, “Dude, Stop” now has a Steam Page! Hit that “Follow” button to not miss any news and add the game to your wishlist if you so desire. You can also head to the discussions section to leave us a note or just add a comment below.


DEMO

The old demo is still available for you to play, and can be found here: Gamejolt
(Please note that the demo is really old and is no longer representable of the game to be released: the visuals have been long since updated and some game mechanics changed).


FAQ

We prepared this FAQ to answer many of the questions from new or old players. If you have more questions – just post below and we will answer and might add them to the list.

Q. When the game will be ready?
A. The game is still under development. We are currently working on the Audio and Voice. The Content (i.e. puzzles) is completely playable and is being thoroughly tested by friends and family. If all goes well, we are going to release the game in the First Half of 2017.

Q. How much will the game cost?
A. We are still in the process of deciding on the price and cannot announce it yet.

Q. Why screenshots show only the old puzzles and nothing new?
A. The number of puzzles we currently have is ways above the demo. Showing the screenshots could spoil the fun and ruin the experience. We promise to show more content prior to release. Some in the form of a new trailer.

Q. There are no trading cards in the list of features! Why?
A. Preparing Trading Cards takes time, that’s why we skipped them (for now) so we could bring you the Store Page as soon as possible. They will be added a little bit later. We already have some awesome ideas, and we hope you will really enjoy collecting them.

Q. Four languages? Is that it? I want you to translate it to the best language in the world – my language!
A. Translating to other languages is a lot of work, so we prioritized languages based on received feedback. That gives us English (duh!), Portuguese (Brazilian), Russian and French. Those will be the available languages for subtitles and UI. The voiceover is currently only available in English. We plan to expand available languages after the release if there is demand. 

Q. How can I follow development progress?
A. You can head to our Facebook page or Twitter, as well as read indieDB blog, or our own website: patomkin.com
